text:
Would you walk 12 minutes to save about ¥9,500? 🧳

We priced the same three December weeknights (Mon 14–Thu 17 Dec, 1 adult) on both sides of Osaka Station:

🏨 By Osaka Station — Hotel Monterey Osaka: ¥34,394
🌿 Near Nakazakicho — Quintessa Hotel Osaka Umeda (rated 8.5): ¥24,920

That's ¥9,474 less over the stay. The catch: it's about 800 m, roughly 12 minutes on foot, from Osaka Station, plus the walk out of the station itself, which is big.

Our take:
👜 Small bag? Walk it.
🧳 Heavy suitcase? Take a taxi on arrival and departure. Osaka taxis start at ¥600, the ride is about 6 minutes, and you still keep roughly ¥7,900.
🚄 Early trains most mornings? Then a hotel on top of the station is worth paying for.

Full price check and route 👉 https://japanbystation.com/nakazakicho-vs-umeda-hotel

Walk, or pay more? 👇
